title: Earth & Moon World
description: The Design page's rotating Earth and Moon, with detailed planetary surfaces, atmospheric lighting, and a field of stars.

title: Expedition Showcase
description: Three distinctive astronaut and spacecraft pairs, with articulated character animations, landing gear, opening cockpits, and interactive orbit controls.

title: Mars Landing
description: A spacecraft descends onto Mars, opens its cockpit, and releases its astronaut to explore the surface. Choose a crew and replay the expedition.

title: Pioneer Flight Deck
description: An immersive spacecraft cockpit with interactive Data, Finance, and AI dashboards, an arrival sequence, and Jupiter beyond the glass.

title: Solar System Journey
description: A cinematic expedition from Earth through Mars and the outer planets, featuring a selectable astronaut and ship, planetary encounters, and journey controls.
